question: A Max-plan user turns off the setting that allows their chats to be used to improve Claude's models. What is the effect?
options: A) Chats are still used for training, but the account is excluded from the de-identification process.
B) Every past conversation is erased from Anthropic's systems immediately once the setting is switched off.
C) Nothing changes until the account is upgraded, since the setting applies only on Team and Enterprise plans.
D) New chats will not be used for future training, and previously stored chats also stop being used.
correct_answers: D) New chats will not be used for future training, and previously stored chats also stop being used.
explanations: Switching the setting off stops the training use; it does not change how data is de-identified.
Turning off a training setting is not the same as deleting stored data.
This is a consumer-plan setting; business plans work differently.
Correct. Switching it off applies to new conversations and stops previously stored ones feeding future training runs.
